Feature availability and differences
(
Updated
:
April 21, 2026
)
CleanMyMac is available from the
MacPaw Store
,
Setapp
, and the
App Store
. If you notice that your copy of CleanMyMac lacks some features mentioned on our official resources, it's most likely because you have the App Store edition.
Apple has strict app review guidelines and doesn't allow certain CleanMyMac functionality. Because of this, we had to adjust, change, or even restrict some features in the App Store edition. Despite these limitations, the app still provides plenty of tools to keep your Mac clean and protected.
The fact that certain features aren't available in the App Store edition doesn't mean they're unsafe or illegal. The App Store restricts some system privileges for all apps to reduce security risks. However, this approach may also prevent safe activities like cleaning system logs or updating apps. As a result, the App Store edition of CleanMyMac can't include some of the features that are otherwise available.
The editions of CleanMyMac from the MacPaw Store and Setapp include the full set of features, while remaining absolutely safe and reliable for your Mac. (
Learn more
about CleanMyMac safety.)
Check below a detailed overview of feature availability across different editions of CleanMyMac.
Note
For details about CleanMyMac availability and purchase options, refer to
Choose your marketplace
.
If you got CleanMyMac from the MacPaw Store or from Setapp and still can't find some of the advertised features,
contact
our Support Team — we're always here for you.
